title: Branding and images
description: The bot’s name, avatar and banner on this server, the backgrounds of the welcome / goodbye cards, and the role icons. The bot applies changes within a few seconds.
tooBigText: It can be at most 4 MB.
badFormatText: A PNG, JPG, GIF or WebP image is required.
botHereText: It only looks like this on this server — elsewhere the bot uses its own name and picture.
updating: The bot is updating its profile…
rateLimit: Discord rate-limits profile changes — if you try many times in a row, wait a few minutes.
goodbyeFallback: If there’s none of its own, the welcome background is used.
cropped: The bot crops it to the card’s aspect ratio.
processing: The bot is processing the image…
roleIconsText: Every role gets an icon that matches its name, in the role’s colour (Owner → crown, Moderator → shield, VIP → star …). If a role’s name starts with an emoji, that becomes the icon.
boostRequired: Discord only allows role icons from boost level 2 — the server is currently on level {tier}.
saved: Icon saved — press “Set icons” to put it on the server.
roleIconsHint: Click a role and pick an icon for it from {count}.
